title: Man. Post. Cap. IV: PLAC — truncates Sexta; misattributes Luc 9:60
pass_a_gloss: PLAC. You see how he contracts that reason of mine, how he truncates it in a great part of itself, how he attributes to me what I did not say, that to die by death is used in Luke 9:60. Let him go on nevertheless.
pass_b_english: PLAC. See how he shrinks that reason of mine, cuts away a large part of it, and credits me with what I never said—that 'to die the death' is used at Luke 9:60. Still, let him go on.
source_text: PLAC. Vides, ut meam istam rationem contrahit, ut magna sui parte truncat, ut mihi tribuit, id quod non dixi, morte mori usurpari Luc. Ix. 60. Pergat tamen.

lemmas.gloss: to die the death is used

choices.choice: Placeus denies he said morte mori at Luc 9:60

notes: Cap. IV GAR Ultimo densify section 252 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 209 tip–211 tip).
